name: Magical Girl Bad End S1
source:
An adventure game (i.e. visual novel) edition of
Felestia Kanon's story from "Magical Girl Bad End S1"!
The beautiful moaning Kanon is now voiced, making the story more immersive!

The story is the same as that of "Magical Girl Bad End S1 (RE231733)"

Enjoy this story of heroine defeat and corruption to a tentacle monster.

[Translation from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ310125.html/?unique_op=af]DLSite[/url]]
